images.title: The chapter on one wall tape
images.purpose: Give a map of the chapter: eight cards under one wall tape, each with one idea and its key fact.
images.composition: A long tape across the top and two rows of four cards below it.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TAPE: one yellow rectangle 1296 px wide and 50 px high (x 80 to 1376, y 50 to 100) with exactly 25 tick marks every 54 px, the tall ticks at every 5th tick. CARDS: exactly 8 rounded rectangles, each 270 by 270 px, in 2 rows of 4 (row 1 at y 170 to 440, row 2 at y 490 to 760; the columns at x 80 to 350, 422 to 692, 764 to 1034 and 1106 to 1376, 72 px apart), filled in order teal #0072B2, amber #E69F00, green #009E73, reddish purple #CC79A7, teal, amber, green, reddish purple, each card with a title in 40 px bold and a fact in 36 px under it. TEXT, row 1: Unit that fits, cm short and m long; One length, two names, 1 m = 100 cm; Compare, same unit first; Kilometre, 1 km = 1,000 m. Row 2: Millimetre, 1 cm = 10 mm; Add and subtract, regroup units; Multiply and divide, each unit part; Feet and inches, 1 foot = 12 inches. In all: 1 tape, 8 cards. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: One key fact from each stop of the chapter.
images.description: A wall tape with eight cards, each with one idea of the chapter and its key fact.
images.context: Concept image for Chapter Revision: Far and Near. It gathers the ideas of the chapter's stops (units, kilometres, millimetres, the four operations and feet and inches) and shows no new example.
images.teaching_notes: Let the child name one thing about each card before reading it. The slip to watch: mixing up 100 and 1,000.
